diagnosis: Prior observer selected ID2 learned from Root inventory, without first enumerating its own enabled surfaces. Browser is not available:2 proves failed exact selection in that actor context; it does not establish that its complete browser inventory is empty. Context ID equivalence is unverified, not a fact.
scope: Read actual actor-local inventories once to distinguish unavailable surface from unverified cross-context ID assumption. Same R139 order, no helper tranche, no getBrowser retry or page action.

roles.resultReviewer: Root independent of both inventory actors

observer.condition: After independently reviewed committed grant and Root dispatch.

producer.condition: Only if observer actual inventory returns at least one supported browser connection; Root reads result and explicitly dispatches. Otherwise NOT_RUN_NO_REDUNDANT_PROBE.

toolProtocol: Exactly one getState call in an invocation; no getBrowser, reset, snapshot followup, documentation request, tab/page/capture/input, recovery retry or fallback stack. Tool error or timeout consumes attempt, retains UNKNOWN/HOLD.
privacy: Record caller-qualified browser-inventory excerpt and original tool-visible provenance; omit unrelated app/window/tab titles, URLs and content. Do not fabricate authenticated raw export or browserSessionId from codexSessionId.
freshAllocation: These metadata inventory attempts are a new Root-selected technical allocation under standing Owner method grant; not reuse of spent discovery or failed selector. No numerical Owner cap is invented.
executionPrecondition: Independent grant review, canonical acknowledgment, repository gates and clean committed grant before either inventory. Actor reads current continuity and records role acknowledgment first.
prohibitedEffects: getBrowser selection/retry or Root capability transfer
page/tab creation, selection, content, capture, navigation or input
resultBoundary: Inventory is diagnostic only, never G0 or product PASS. Empty/error observer inventory preserves HOLD and stops all other calls. A candidate permits only Root planning/rebinding and independent review, not implicit selection/campaign.
